description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththetiya Meda, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820003 (22/14/23/0025)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details of land ownership, property boundaries, cadastral information, and encumbrances like mortgages. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
